title: The Sharp Directions Are Against You: Curvature Analysis of Activation Steering
abstract: arXiv:2610.16084v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Activation steering adds a vector to a language model's internal representations at inference time. It is a lightweight alternative to fine-tuning for behavioral control. The standard construction, contrastive activation addition (CAA), is fragile, as on many inputs it shifts behavior in the wrong direction. To explain this fragility, we first study the geometry of the steering vector. We introduce steering Hessian, the matrix of second order derivative of the model's behavioral loss with respect to the steering vector. It captures the output behavior response sensitivity of the model under small perturbations of the steering vector along each direction. Its top eigenvectors are sharp directions: tiny perturbations along them can cause large, erratic, input-dependent behavioral swings. translated_title: 尖锐方向对你不利：激活引导的曲率分析
translated_abstract: 激活引导在推理时向语言模型的内部表示中添加一个向量，是用于行为控制的一种轻量级微调替代方案。标准构造方法——对比激活添加（CAA）——十分脆弱，因为在许多输入上它会把模型行为引导向错误的方向。为了解释这种脆弱性，我们首先研究了引导向量的几何特性。我们提出了“引导Hessian矩阵”，即模型行为损失关于引导向量的二阶导数矩阵。它刻画了当引导向量沿各个方向受到微小扰动时，模型输出行为的响应敏感度。该矩阵的顶部特征向量对应“尖锐方向”：沿这些方向的微小扰动可能引发剧烈的、不稳定的、依赖于输入的行为波动。底部特征向量则对应“平坦方向”：沿这些方向的行为是稳健的。移除引导向量中的尖锐分量，可以在近似保持其引导方向的同时……
tldr: 本文提出“引导Hessian”曲率分析方法，揭示了引导向量中尖锐方向（顶部特征向量）会导致不稳定的行为波动，而移除这些尖锐分量可以在保持引导效果的同时显著提升激活引导的稳健性。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces the "steering Hessian" for curvature analysis of activation steering, showing that sharp directions cause erratic behavioral swings, and removing the sharp components of steering vectors preserves steering effectiveness while greatly improving robustness.
